LAFAN1.label: LaFAN1
LAFAN1.origin: Ubisoft La Forge Animation Dataset (LaFAN1): 5 subjects, 77 sequences, 4.6 hours (Harvey et al., Robust Motion In-Betweening, SIGGRAPH 2020). A loop out of every walking, running and sprinting take; the falls, fights, jumps, dances and obstacle courses are there to cut with mocap cut.
